surface: plate-pr-gates main-source check, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, gh plate pr preflight
summary: PRs into main must come from release branches unless main-source-override is applied; enforced in pr-gates and local preflight.
migration_impact: After upgrade, Feature/Bug/Documentation PRs must target a release integration branch (see gh plate release status). Regenerate or import plate-pr-gates.yml. Add the main-source-override label for rare exceptions.
agent_notes: Run gh plate pr preflight before gh pr create --base main. Release PRs use release or release-v* heads. Infrastructure PRs to main need an approver to apply main-source-override until lifecycle approvers (#1425) restrict the label.
